notes.title: The DLC MotoGP™15 GP de Portugal Circuito Estoril is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CVXoh-ZWEAA1VGY.jpg:large[/IMG]

Milestone announces that starting from today the DLC MotoGP™15 GP de Portugal Circuito Estoril and related Patch are available on MotoGP™15. This new downloadable content adds a new track to the already existing ones. The content will be playable onGrand Prix, Championship, Time Attack, Grand Prix Online and Championship Online.

The Estoril Circuit has been designer for both 2 and 4 wheels. It’s located around the touristic city Estoril, in the south of Portugal. It held 13 editions of GP de Portugal (from 2000 till 2012) hand kept its shape till 1996. The only slight chance till ’96 was the inclusion of a strict variant into the final part of the track for security reason. After 1996, the track has been subject to some major changes like: the first two corners have been slowed down; the exit of the pit lane now join the track after the first corner; the chicane included into 1994 has been enlarged to make it faster and the last corner has been “anticipated” in order to create a significant escape route.

With the new DLC MotoGP™ 15 GP de Portugal Circuito Estoril there will be patch that fixes the following issues: 

[b]Windows PC®/STEAM™[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added support for additional content MotoGP™15 GP de Portugal Circuito Estoril
[/list]

The new MotoGP™15 GP de Portugal Circuito Estoril is now available for free for those who have already bought MotoGP™15 Season Pass, and for those who have a copy of MotoGP™15 for €3,99 for all consoles and for Windows PC/STEAM™.

notes.title: Released the MotoGP™15 Redbull Rookies Cup DLC
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i61.tinypic.com/161j4g0.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Milestone[/b] announces that starting from today the [b]DLC MotoGP™15 Red Bull Rookies Cups[/b] is available on MotoGP™15. This new downloadable content adds a new category to the already existing ones – MotoGP™, Moto2™ and Moto3™ – and makes the Rookies Cup riders available in all game modes, except Career, Sprint Season, Beat The time, Real Events 2014 and Split Times. 

Like in a real GP, it will be possible to ride as a real Rookie rider on the Official Tracks at: Jerez (Spain), Assen (Netherlands), Sachsenring (Germany), Brno (Czech Republic), Silverstone (Great Britain), Misano (Italy) and Aragon (Spain). 

[b]The riders’ roster will be updated with 24 riders from the Red Bull MotoGP™ Rookies Cup.[/b] 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b7ElV1jKeWE] ---> Watch the video! <---	[/url]

[b]Red Bull MotoGP™ Rookies Cup.[/b] Since its inception in 2007 it has grown into one of the most thrilling 2 wheel spectacles in the world. Teenagers from around the world know that the best way of getting a start in Grand Prix motorcycle racing is by entering the Red Bull MotoGP™ Rookies Cup. Every year the level of competition has climbed and this year’s intake is set to raise the bar yet again. The 2013 season also saw changes both to the calendar and the machinery with the Cup adopting the stunning KTM RC 250 R 4-stroke Moto3 machine and finally saying goodbye to the 2-stroke KTM RC 125 that has powered the competition for the last 6 seasons.

notes.title: MotoGP™15 – Patch
notes.content:
[img]http://i59.tinypic.com/2889mdy.png[/img]

Dear Gamers,

we apologize for the issues you were facing in this days, we're happy to inform you that we've yet released a patch to solve them.

[b]You can find below the changelog:[/b]

- Improved stability in many game areas
- Fix for grey windshield in cockpit camera for Moto 3 - KTM RC250GP and Moto 3 - Husqvarna FR250GP
- Fix for grey windshield in 3rd person camera for Moto 3 - KTM RC 250 GP
- Fix for achievement "Milano-Valencia one way!"
- Fix for achievement 'The flying wings!', 'The fastest diapason', 'It was a long time', 'Back from Italy' and 'The Red Baron', now unlocked in any game mode
- AI riders visible on track when racing in qualifying sessions
- Fix for rain particles effect
- Fix for rain effect when light rain weather is selected
- Fix for dirt and scratches effects on riders
- Fixed bike names on leaderboards
- Various minor fixes

Please help us to improve your game experience by reporting issues on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/355130/discussions/0/530645446306410539/ ]Bug Thread[/url]

notes.title: MotoGP™15 - 4 Strokes Champions and Events DLC
notes.content:
Hi Gamers,

Extend your riding experience with the [b]4 Strokes Champions and Events DLC[/b] that adds a new category and 18 new challenge events! 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/373200/]  [IMG]http://i61.tinypic.com/358dhkw.jpg[/IMG]  [/url] 
Ride the 1.000cc MotoGP™ bikes that competed between 2004 and 2006, with their powerful engines, and less electronics than today's bikes. Choose from 20 riders across 13 teams, for a total of 7 different manufacturers.

notes.title: MotoGP™15 - Announcement !
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i59.tinypic.com/2889mdy.png[/IMG]
Hi Gamers!

We’re proud to announce [b]MotoGP™15[/b], the third chapter in the series dedicated to one of the most adrenaline-fuelled championships in the world: MotoGP™. The title will be available the 19th June, 2015.

[i]Bike, rider, and team customisation. Enhanced career mode. New game mode. Legendary two-stroke bikes. The 2015 MotoGP™ Season.[/i] These are the ingredients that promise to revolutionise the game experience for all competitive motorcycling enthusiasts and MotoGP™ championship fans.

One of the standout features of this new chapter dedicated to the motorcycle world championship season - a defining characteristic of the 2015 edition of the official videogame of the MotoGP™ - is [u]bike, rider, and team customisation[/u], with more than 100 accessories available for purchase*. Bike: choose from more than 20 bike models across 3 classes, MotoGP™, Moto2™ and Moto3™, choose from 40 different liveries with official colour schemes, and consider offers from the main sponsors to accept their sponsorship during races. Rider: change the colour scheme of your leathers to match your bike, buy boots and gloves, choose your rider's face and helmet. Motorhome: transform your game experience with 3 different motorhomes (Basic, Mid-Range and Top-Range), so your avatar can live in a manner befitting to their level of stardom.
[i]* All of the 100+ accessories and the 3 motorhomes are available right away, and can be purchased with GP Credits, a virtual currency that can be earned in any race mode, online and offline.[/i]

The second highlight of the new title is the [u]enhanced career mode[/u], now fully integrated with the customisation features. Once you have created your, you start out on the road to becoming world champion. You'll start racing as a Wild Card and subsequently you'll be able to negotiate your future career by choosing one of the official teams participating in the 2015 championship, or choosing sponsors to race with your own Private Team, taking to the track alongside the existing teams. Negotiations hinge on your performance during races, meaning your customisation options and resulting appearance are directly linked to your in-game objectives.

The third new component is the introduction of a [u]new game-mode[/u]: Beat the Time. In this compelling new race players are assigned a specific bike on a specific circuit. Riders from the different classes featured in the game have set records on that circuit and on that bike. Your aim is to beat that record.

Other new features for MotoGP™15 include the introduction of the [u]two-stroke bikes[/u] that made MotoGP™ history, all the teams, riders and bikes from the 2015 season, and Real Events from the 2014 season, for a complete experience that is unique in its genre.

Follow us on

- [url=http://www.motogpvideogame.com] Official Website [/url]
